name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi
description: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per year to all landholding farmer families, paid in three equal installments of ₹2,000 every four months. Transferred directly to the farmer's bank account via DBT.
eligibility: Farmer family with cultivable land holding
Land must be in the name of the farmer or family members
Valid Aadhaar number
Active bank account linked to Aadhaar
applySteps: Visit the official PM-KISAN portal or nearest Common Service Centre (CSC)
Self-register using Aadhaar number and mobile OTP
Upload land records and bank account details
Submit the application — status is tracked on the portal
Installments are released on 1st of April, August, and December each year after verification

name: Namo Shetkari Mahasanman Nidhi Yojana (Maharashtra)
description: Top-up income support from the Government of Maharashtra of ₹6,000 per year over and above PM-KISAN. Combined benefit of ₹12,000 per year for eligible Maharashtra farmers. Paid in three installments.
eligibility: Resident farmer of Maharashtra
Land holding in the name of the farmer in Maharashtra
Already registered under PM-KISAN (preferred, not mandatory)
Bank account in Maharashtra linked to Aadhaar
applySteps: Register on the Maharashtra NSMNY portal or through your local Gram Sevak
Link your PM-KISAN registration number (if available)
Submit 7/12 extracts for all land parcels
Verification is done at Taluka Agriculture Office level
Installments are released by the Maharashtra Agriculture Department via DBT

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
description: Crop insurance scheme that protects farmers against yield loss due to natural calamities (drought, flood, hail, pest attack). Premium is heavily subsidized: 2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi, 5% for commercial/horticultural crops.
benefitLabel: Sum insured = Notional value of crop · Premium 1.5% - 5% only
eligibility: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas
Loanee farmers (KCC) are mandatory covered; non-loanee voluntary
Sharecroppers and tenant farmers (with documented proof) are eligible
Enrollment before sowing season cutoff date
applySteps: Approach your nearest bank branch (KCC) or insurance company office or CSC before sowing cutoff
Fill the PMFBY enrollment form with crop name, area, sowing date
Pay the subsidized premium (2% Kharif / 1.5% Rabi / 5% commercial)
Receive the insurance certificate — keep it safe
In case of crop loss: report within 72 hours via portal/CSC, apply for claim, receive on-the-spot assessment, claim via DBT

name: Kisan Credit Card
description: Revolving crop loan credit card with 4% effective interest rate (on prompt repayment). Covers production credit for crops, working capital for allied activities, and contingency needs. ATM-enabled RuPay card for cash withdrawals.
benefitLabel: Up to ₹3 lakh · 7% interest · 4% after 3% subsidy (prompt repayment)
eligibility: All individual farmers / joint borrowers who are owner-cultivators
Tenant farmers, oral lessees, sharecroppers
Self-Help Groups (SHGs) or Joint Liability Groups (JLGs) of farmers
No minimum land required for small/marginal farmers
documents: Land records or tenant / sharecropper agreement
applySteps: Visit your nearest bank branch (SBI, PNB, BOI, cooperative bank or any scheduled commercial bank)
Fill the KCC application form with details of crops, area, land holding
Submit Aadhaar, land records, photographs — no collateral for loans up to ₹1.6 lakh
Bank appraises and sanctions the credit limit within 10-15 days
Receive RuPay Kisan Credit Card — use it for purchase of inputs, ATM withdrawal, POS transactions

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthaan Mahabhiyan
description: Subsidy on solar pumps for irrigation and installation of grid-connected solar power plants on barren/fallow land. Three components: Component A (10 GW solar plants), Component B (1.75 mn standalone solar pumps), Component C (1 mn grid-connected solarized pumps).
benefitLabel: 60% - 80% subsidy on solar pumps · Balance can be on easy EMI
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers for standalone pumps (Component B)
All farmers for grid-connected pumps (Component C)
Farmer groups / cooperatives / panchayats for large solar plants (Component A)
Barren or fallow land available for solar plant installation
documents: Caste certificate (for additional state-level subsidy if applicable)
applySteps: Apply on the PM-KUSUM portal or through your DISCOM office / state Nodal Agency
Choose Component B (standalone pump) or C (grid-connected)
Submit land records, electricity bill copy, Aadhaar, bank details
Approval → empaneled vendor installs the pump / solar plant → inspection by DISCOM → subsidy released directly to vendor
Farmer pays remaining 20-40% share; can be financed via NABARD loan

name: Magel Tyala Solar Krushi Pump Yojana (Maharashtra)
description: Maharashtra State scheme providing solar agricultural pumps to farmers at just 5-10% of actual cost. Farmers get 3 HP / 5 HP / 7.5 HP solar pumps depending on category. Priority to small/marginal, SC/ST, women farmers, drought-prone talukas.
benefitLabel: Farmer pays only 5% - 10% of cost · Rest 90%+ subsidy
eligibility: Resident farmer of Maharashtra
Own cultivable land with confirmed irrigation requirement
Priority order: SC/ST → Small/Marginal → Women → General
No existing grid-connected electric pump on the survey number (for some categories)
applySteps: Apply online on Maharashtra Krishi Department portal or via Taluka Agriculture Officer
Application is considered as per annual quota and priority category
Once selected, pay the farmer share (5-10%) via online challan
Empaneled agency installs solar pump, conducts technical inspection
After TAO verification, pump is handed over with 5-year AMC warranty

name: Pradhan Mantri Annadata Aay SanraksHan Abhiyan
description: Umbrella scheme guaranteeing Minimum Support Price (MSP) to farmers for notified crops. Three sub-schemes: Price Support Scheme (PSS) — direct procurement by NAFED/FCI, Price Deficiency Payment Scheme (PDPS) — pays the MSP difference to farmer's bank if mandi price is below MSP, Pilot of Private Procurement & Stockist Scheme (PPPS).
benefitLabel: MSP gap made good via PDPS or direct procurement
eligibility: Farmer growing MSP-notified crops in the state/UT where the scheme is notified
Crop sown within the sowing window and sold within notified marketing season
Sale at designated mandi (for PSS) or proof of sale at sub-MSP price (for PDPS)
Land records and Aadhaar-linked bank account
documents: Sale receipt from mandi (J-Form / auction slip)
applySteps: During sowing season, register your crop, area and variety at the nearest APMC / CSC
Harvest and bring produce to designated APMC mandi
Sell either to procurement agency at MSP (PSS) OR to any buyer in mandi (PDPS)
If sold below MSP, PDPS deficiency amount is auto-calculated and credited to your account within 15 days
You can track status on the NAFED / state agriculture portal

name: Electronic National Agriculture Market (e-NAM)
description: All-India electronic trading portal integrating 1,656+ regulated APMC mandis into a single national market. Farmers can sell produce online to buyers across India, get transparent price discovery, avoid commission agent exploitation, and receive payment directly in bank account within hours.
benefitLabel: Free enrollment · Trade across 1,656+ mandis · Direct bank payment
eligibility: All farmers, regardless of land holding
Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs)
Traders / commission agents with valid license (as buyers)
Must be registered at an eNAM-integrated mandi
documents: APMC farmer registration number / Kisan ID
applySteps: Visit your nearest eNAM integrated APMC mandi
Meet the Mandi eNAM Manager or a local CSC for one-time registration
Provide Aadhaar, bank account, and existing APMC farmer ID — biometric eKYC done on spot
You receive eNAM farmer ID and login credentials for the eNAM mobile app
List your produce (lot) via app or mandi entry counter → bidding happens → accept best bid → payment within 4 hours to bank account

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
description: Free soil testing to all farmers once every 2-3 years. A printed card shows 12 parameters: N, P, K, S, Zn, Fe, Cu, Mn, Bo, pH, EC, OC — along with crop-specific fertilizer and amendment recommendations. Saves cost on excessive fertilizer use.
eligibility: All farmers with cultivable land holding
No minimum or maximum land requirement
Every farm parcel is tested once in a 2-3 year cycle
You can apply more frequently at a nominal charge
applySteps: Approach your nearest Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK), ATMA office, or Block Agriculture Officer
Provide your survey number, area, current crop, irrigation source
Soil sample is collected by extension worker OR you can collect it as per instructions (10-15 spots, depth 6-9 in)
Sample tested at government soil testing lab — results are ready in 2-4 weeks
Soil Health Card is printed and delivered at doorstep or available online on the portal

name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana — Per Drop More Crop
description: Subsidy on drip irrigation and sprinkler irrigation systems. Enables 55-90% subsidy (varies by category and state) on approved system cost. Increases yield 30-40%, reduces water consumption 40-60%, saves fertilizer, and allows fertigation.
eligibility: All farmers, small and marginal, who own or lease cultivable land
Farmer groups, FPOs, cooperatives can apply collectively
Water source available (well / borewell / canal / water body) of sufficient capacity
Area minimum: 0.2 ha (0.5 acre) for drip, 0.4 ha (1 acre) for sprinkler
documents: Land records or registered lease / tenant agreement
applySteps: Apply at the Block Agriculture Office / ATMA / online on state PMKSY portal
Submit layout sketch of the field showing water source, location of proposed system
Technical feasibility check — approval letter from Horticulture / Agriculture department
Pay 10-45% farmer share in advance or through bank loan
Empaneled vendor installs the system, joint inspection by department → subsidy released to vendor → farmer gets free 1-year training + 2-year warranty

name: Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krushi Swabhiman Yojana (Maharashtra)
description: Comprehensive support scheme for Scheduled Caste (SC) and Scheduled Tribe (ST) farmers in Maharashtra. Benefits include land development, free seed kits, farm equipment subsidy, micro-irrigation subsidy, marketing support, agricultural training, and support to women SC/ST farmer groups.
benefitLabel: 100% seed kits · Up to ₹1 lakh equipment subsidy · Priority on all agri schemes
eligibility: Farmer belonging to Scheduled Caste (SC) or Scheduled Tribe (ST) as per caste certificate
Resident of Maharashtra with cultivable land holding (or identified as landless agricultural laborer with alternative)
Priority given to women farmers within SC/ST category
Aadhaar-linked bank account
documents: Caste certificate (SC/ST) issued by competent authority
7/12 land record if land owner; laborer registration if landless
Women applicants: self-declaration or Aadhaar gender
applySteps: Approach your nearest District Level SC/ST Welfare Officer or Taluka Agriculture Officer
Register under the scheme with required caste and land documents
Choose benefit component: seed kit → equipment → micro-irrigation → land development → training
District Committee verifies and sanctions benefit as per annual quota
Seeds, equipment are distributed through departmental distribution camps; monetary components via DBT

name: Maha Agri AI Mission (Maharashtra)
description: AI-driven agriculture mission of Maharashtra Government. Provides hyperlocal crop advisories, pest & disease prediction, weather-based alerts, market price forecast, and digital land record services. Integrated with Kisan360-style dashboards for demonstration to Amul-type FPO clusters.
benefitLabel: Free AI advisory · Weather + pest + market alerts in Marathi · WhatsApp push
eligibility: All Maharashtra-based farmers
Smartphone not mandatory — alerts reach via SMS, WhatsApp, or village-level extension worker
FPOs get priority access to data dashboards and market matching
Pilot districts get enhanced coverage first; rest phased in
documents: Survey number of the farm (to get hyperlocal data)
applySteps: Give a missed call to the designated Maha Agri AI number or register via CSC / Gram Sevak
You will receive onboarding SMS — confirm your district, taluka, village, survey number and primary crops
Within 48 hours your profile is created in the mission's platform
You receive regular advisories in Marathi: pest alerts, sowing windows, weather warnings, mandi price trends
If you own a smartphone, you can also use the mobile app to access your personalised dashboard, and connect to the FPO marketplace
